CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.objectBytes_split : ∀ (before : List CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field)
  (selected : CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field) (after : List CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field),
  CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.objectBytes (before ++ selected :: after) =
    CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.prefixBytes before selected ++ selected.payload.data.toList ++
      CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.suffixBytes after
CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.artifact_checkBytes : ∀ (before : List CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field)
  (selected : CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field) (after : List CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.Field)
  (artifact : ByteArray),
  artifact.data = (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.encode (before ++ selected :: after)).data →
    CurrentMain.CheckedArraySlice.checkBytes artifact selected.payload
        (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.offset before selected) =
      true

@CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.recover_layout : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray)
  (entries : List (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry n)) (i : Fin entries.length)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.recover n artifact entries i update coefficients = some r →
    (∀ f ∈ CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries, CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.keyPolicy f.key = true) ∧
      (List.map (fun f => CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.keyBytes f.key)
            (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries)).Nodup ∧
        artifact.data =
            (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.prefixBytes (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.beforeFields entries i)
                    (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.toField
                      (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i))).toArray ++
                (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload
                    (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns).data ++
              (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.suffixBytes
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.afterFields entries i)).toArray ∧
          CurrentMain.CheckedArraySlice.checkBytes artifact
                (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns)
                (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.offset entries i) =
              true ∧
            r.columns = (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns
@CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.recover_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray)
  (entries : List (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry n)) (i : Fin entries.length)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.recover n artifact entries i update coefficients = some r →
    r.columns = (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns ∧
      (∃ wholeText dictionary text raw,
          String.fromUTF8? artifact = some wholeText ∧
            Lean.Json.parse wholeText = Except.ok dictionary ∧
              String.fromUTF8?
                    (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload
                      (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns) =
                  some text ∧
                Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok raw ∧
                  dictionary.getObjVal? (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).key = Except.ok raw ∧
                    CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.decodeColumns n raw = some r.columns ∧
                      CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                          (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
                        raw) ∧
        CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
            ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
          (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
              CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                  ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
                x) ∧
            ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
              (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
                x

@CurrentMain.KeyOnlyCompactObject.recover_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray) (keys : List String) (position : ℕ)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.KeyOnlyCompactObject.recover n artifact keys position update coefficients = some r →
    (∃ text dictionary entries,
        ∃ (hi : position < entries.length),
          String.fromUTF8? artifact = some text ∧
            Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok dictionary ∧
              List.map CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry.key entries = keys ∧
                position < keys.length ∧
                  (∀ entry ∈ entries,
                      ∃ raw,
                        dictionary.getObjVal? entry.key = Except.ok raw ∧
                          CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                                (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue entry.columns) =
                              raw ∧
                            ∀ (j : Fin n),
                              CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction entry.columns j < 2 ^ n) ∧
                    CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.checkKeys (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries) = true ∧
                      artifact.data =
                          (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.encode (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries)).data ∧
                        r.columns = (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries ⟨position, hi⟩).columns ∧
                          CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.recover n artifact entries ⟨position, hi⟩ update
                              coefficients =
                            some r) ∧
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
          ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
        (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
              x) ∧
          ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
              x
@CurrentMain.KeyOnlyCompactObject.recover_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray) (dictionary : Lean.Json)
  (entries : List (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry n)) (i : Fin entries.length)
  (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n) (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc :
    c.columns =
      CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction
        (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns),
  (∀ entry ∈ entries,
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary entry.key = some entry.columns) →
    CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.checkKeys (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries) = true →
      artifact.data = (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.encode (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries)).data →
        CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes artifact = Except.ok dictionary →
          CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes
                (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns) =
              Except.ok
                (CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                  (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue
                    (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns)) →
            CurrentMain.KeyOnlyCompactObject.recover n artifact
                (List.map CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry.key entries) (↑i) c.updateVector c.coefficients =
              some
                { columns := (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩,
                  column_match := ⋯ }
